title: Tapping Comparison & Selection Mode

critical_finding_fixed.description: T8's already-committed inline script (commit c13e541) contained a JS syntax error (\" inside an outer template literal resolves to an unescaped " in emitted HTML), which prevented the ENTIRE inline <script> block from executing in any browser -- confirmed by extracting and node --check-ing the script directly from the committed file, not the working tree.
critical_finding_fixed.impact: T8's interactivity (system/designation selection, result rendering) has never worked in production. Execution failure, not a data-correctness issue -- no wrong value was ever shown, because the tool never ran at all.
critical_finding_fixed.fix: One-line change: switched the offending string from double-quoted-with-escapes to single-quoted, matching the pattern already used correctly elsewhere in the same file.
critical_finding_fixed.why_missed_in_t8: T8's validator checked required strings/structure via regex but never parsed the script as JavaScript.
critical_finding_fixed.gap_closed: Added a new_Function()-based real syntax-validity check to validate-tapping-workflow.js (now check #1), plus an actual DOM-mock execution test exercising the full interaction path (selection, rendering, comparison add/remove/compare/clear, 4-item cap, duplicate prevention, ISO alternative rendering for both metric and UNC records) to verify runtime behavior, not just syntax.

comparison_capability.location: Interactive state within the existing /tools/tapping-workflow page -- no new URL

iso_alternative_handling.metric_columns_show: Not applicable — ISO 2306 is already the metric convention for this record.
iso_alternative_handling.unc_unf_columns_show: value + unit + verification status + non-replacement note

tap_type_preservation: Relevant tap types row lists the same projection-resolved tap_types array as the single-result view; no inference, no 'best/recommended tap' language
engagement_handling: Fixed exact limitation sentence repeated per column; zero numeric values anywhere
standards_handling: Comparison rows read directly from each record's own resolved standards array; no new standards relationship inferred

regression_checksums.tapping_workflow_html_change_reason: comparison feature UI/logic added, plus the syntax-error fix

runtime_dom_test.method: Minimal hand-built DOM mock (createElement/getElementById/event dispatch, textContent-to-innerHTML escaping matching real browser behavior) executing the extracted inline script directly
scenarios_exercised: compare selected renders table with correct field values
ISO 2306 alternative correct for UNC record and 'Not applicable' for metric record in the same comparison

deferred_findings: Comparison selection does not persist across page reload (no URL/query-string encoding) -- new-URL creation was explicitly prohibited, and this wasn't requested
No automatic difference-highlighting -- avoided to prevent implying an engineering judgment the data doesn't support
